assessments.reasoning: Condition 1 of the publisher LICENSE states the origin restriction and separately addresses acknowledgment.

challenge.method: Compared two cases under condition 1: a product manual that omits acknowledgment and one that expressly credits the distributor with writing the original software.
challenge.results: The condition expressly permits omission of the acknowledgment. A false claim to original authorship falls within the prohibition even when it appears in product documentation.

limitations: The provision prescribes no universal placement for credit. Assessing an actual representation would require its wording and context.
reasoning: Condition 1 prohibits misrepresenting the software’s origin. Claiming authorship of the original is the specific example the condition gives.
